issues.description: Large empty decorative blocks on the left and lower-right outweigh the actual menu and make the background feel more dominant than supportive, reducing focus on the central actions.
The mobile menu is not reflowed to a bottom-weighted thumb-friendly stack as planned; it appears like a reduced desktop composition floating mid-screen.
Play is only slightly taller than Settings and Credits, so the primary CTA is not unmistakably dominant at first glance.
The tablet layout keeps all three actions too similar in emphasis; Play does not separate itself enough from the secondary actions.
The settings panel has excessive unused lower space while the active controls are compressed into the top half, creating an accidental dead zone inside the modal.
Credits content is crowded into the upper-left while a large portion of the panel remains unused, making the panel feel unfinished and poorly balanced.
The Credits title overlaps the body copy region and the body starts too close to the header, hurting readability and panel structure.
Header title, close button, labels, value text, and slider do not resolve to a strong shared grid; row geometry feels loosely placed rather than intentionally aligned.
The credits panel header and body are not aligned to a clear inset system; the close button, title, and text block feel independently positioned.
Main buttons are grouped coherently, but the overall screen still feels sparse because the composition occupies too little of the safe area relative to the background masses.
Mobile decoration and container sizing remain too similar to desktop proportions, indicating uniform shrink rather than a deliberate mobile simplification and re-balance.
The credits panel looks like a scaled container with weak finishing detail in the content area; the ornate skin is stronger than the internal layout and copy treatment.
The play, settings, and credits icons are distinct, but their internal detail and apparent weight are not fully harmonized; the credits icon reads denser and noisier than the others.

repairInstructions: Reduce or reposition the large background rectangles so the menu remains the focal point; keep the dark native backdrop and thin horizon lines, but make decoration quieter than the action dock.

Rebuild the phone layout as an actual mobile composition: move the dock lower for thumb reach, tighten vertical spacing slightly, and resize decorative background shapes independently instead of uniformly shrinking desktop.

Increase Play prominence through a clearly taller button, stronger gold highlight treatment, or extra vertical separation above the secondary buttons while preserving the existing icon family and label.
Redistribute content inside SettingsModal so the lower half is used intentionally: expand row spacing, move the slider/value block lower, or shorten the panel height.
Rework CreditsModal internal layout with a defined header band and body block; separate title from body text and use the panel space more evenly.
Add a consistent inset grid to both modals so titles, close buttons, labels, values, and body copy share common left/right edges.
Preserve the glossy cyan/cobalt skins, live text, and existing close icon treatment, but improve internal padding and hierarchy rather than regenerating all artwork.
On tablet, give Play the same dominance fix as desktop and confirm the menu scale sits intentionally between phone and desktop rather than matching desktop too closely.

preserve: Glossy cyan/cobalt button and panel skin family.
Live readable text approach instead of baked lettering.
Distinct required actions only: Play, Settings, Credits, and Close.
Consistent close-button visual family across both panels.
Dark restrained backdrop direction with minimal line accents.
modify: BackgroundRoot decoration sizing and opacity in desktop, phone, and tablet to stop it overpowering the menu.
MainMenuDock positioning on phone so it becomes lower-centered and thumb-friendly.
PlayButton scale and highlight treatment to create unmistakable CTA hierarchy over SettingsButton and CreditsButton.
SettingsModal height or internal row distribution to eliminate the large unused lower region.
CreditsModal header/body spacing so CreditsTitle and CreditsBody no longer collide and the panel feels intentionally filled.
Inset and alignment grid for SettingsTitle, SettingsCloseButton, MusicLabel, VolumeLabel, VolumeValue, VolumeSlider, CreditsTitle, CreditsBody, and CreditsCloseButton.
CreditsButton icon sizing/detail balance to better match PlayButton and SettingsButton icon weight.
remove: Excessively large empty decorative background blocks that visually compete with the menu.
The current crowded top-left credits text placement inside CreditsModal.
add: A clearer internal header band structure in CreditsModal with dedicated spacing below the title.
More intentional vertical distribution within SettingsModal, using either larger row gaps or a lower slider block.
A stronger desktop/tablet-to-phone responsive reflow rather than proportional downscaling.
